entries.answer: HERE, NEXT BOSS, EVOLUTIONS and the DEX read the randomizer's POKéMON, teams, moves and items from the game itself. The gift and legendary POKéMON it moved aren't listed: the guide can't know them.
entries.title: This game is randomized

entries.answer: Hold B to run once you have the RUNNING SHOES.
entries.title: Running

entries.answer: The VS SEEKER finds trainers who want a rematch. It recharges as you walk.
entries.title: Rematches

randomized.answer: Press L or R almost anywhere for the game's own HELP menu (OPTION: BUTTON MODE = HELP, the default).
randomized.title: In-game help

entries.answer: Poison keeps hurting while you walk and can make a POKéMON faint. Cure it or heal at a POKéMON CENTER.
entries.title: Poison outside battle

randomized.answer: In this generation it's decided by the move's TYPE, not the move. FIRE, WATER, GRASS, ELECTRIC, ICE, PSYCHIC, DRAGON and DARK moves are special; NORMAL, FIGHTING, FLYING, POISON, GROUND, ROCK, BUG, GHOST and STEEL are physical.
randomized.title: Physical or special?

entries.answer: HM moves can't be forgotten normally. The MOVE DELETER in FUCHSIA CITY removes them.
entries.title: Getting rid of an HM move

entries.answer: The MOVE RELEARNER on TWO ISLAND teaches a forgotten move for a BIG MUSHROOM or two TINY MUSHROOMS.
entries.title: Relearning moves

randomized.answer: FLASH: BOULDER. CUT: CASCADE. FLY: THUNDER. STRENGTH: RAINBOW. SURF: SOUL. ROCK SMASH: MARSH. WATERFALL: VOLCANO. A POKéMON in the party must know the move too.
randomized.title: Which badge unlocks which HM?

randomized.answer: 600 steps per visit. You can't use your own POKéMON - throw bait or rocks, then SAFARI BALLS.
randomized.title: How long do I have?

entries.answer: Get a BIKE VOUCHER from the chairman of the POKéMON FAN CLUB in VERMILION CITY, then trade it at CERULEAN CITY's bike shop.
entries.hint: Someone in VERMILION CITY loves to talk about his POKéMON.
entries.title: BICYCLE

entries.answer: An AIDE in the VERMILION CITY POKéMON CENTER.
entries.hint: In a POKéMON CENTER.
entries.title: VS SEEKER

entries.answer: The FISHING GURU in a house in VERMILION CITY.
entries.hint: A port town.
entries.title: OLD ROD

entries.answer: A fisherman's house in FUCHSIA CITY.
entries.hint: The city with the SAFARI ZONE.
entries.title: GOOD ROD

entries.answer: The FISHING HOUSE on ROUTE 12.
entries.hint: On the long pier south of LAVENDER TOWN.
entries.title: SUPER ROD

entries.answer: PROF. OAK's AIDE upstairs in the ROUTE 11 gate, once you've caught 30 kinds of POKéMON.
entries.hint: An AIDE east of VERMILION CITY.
entries.title: ITEMFINDER

entries.answer: PROF. OAK's AIDE upstairs in the ROUTE 15 gate, once you've caught 50 kinds of POKéMON.
entries.hint: An AIDE west of FUCHSIA CITY.
entries.title: EXP. SHARE

randomized.answer: PROF. OAK's AIDE gives them to you as you leave PEWTER CITY after beating BROCK.
randomized.title: RUNNING SHOES

entries.answer: A house on ROUTE 16, behind a small tree (use CUT).
entries.hint: West of CELADON CITY.
entries.title: HM02 FLY

entries.answer: The SECRET HOUSE deep in the SAFARI ZONE.
entries.hint: In the SAFARI ZONE.
entries.title: HM03 SURF

entries.answer: Find the GOLD TEETH in the SAFARI ZONE's west area and return them to the WARDEN in FUCHSIA CITY.
entries.hint: Someone in FUCHSIA CITY lost something in the SAFARI ZONE.
entries.title: HM04 STRENGTH

entries.answer: PROF. OAK's AIDE in the building on ROUTE 2, once you've caught 10 kinds of POKéMON.
entries.hint: An AIDE near DIGLETT's CAVE.
entries.title: HM05 FLASH

entries.answer: The EMBER SPA on KINDLE ROAD (ONE ISLAND).
entries.hint: A hot spring on the SEVII ISLANDS.
entries.title: HM06 ROCK SMASH

entries.answer: Inside ICEFALL CAVE on FOUR ISLAND.
entries.hint: A frozen cave on the SEVII ISLANDS.
entries.title: HM07 WATERFALL

randomized.answer: The captain of the S.S. ANNE in VERMILION CITY - visit him before the ship leaves.
randomized.title: HM01 CUT

entries.answer: A house in FUCHSIA CITY.
entries.title: MOVE DELETER

entries.answer: A house on TWO ISLAND. Bring a BIG MUSHROOM or two TINY MUSHROOMS.
entries.title: MOVE RELEARNER

randomized.answer: CELADON DEPT. STORE 4F sells FIRE, THUNDER, WATER and LEAF STONES. MOON STONES are found, e.g. in MT. MOON.
randomized.title: Evolution stones

entries.answer: The rooftop room of the CELADON CONDOMINIUMS - reached by the back entrance.
entries.hint: CELADON CITY.
entries.title: EEVEE

entries.answer: An employee on SILPH CO. 7F, after you reach him during the ROCKET takeover.
entries.hint: SAFFRON CITY.
entries.title: LAPRAS

entries.answer: Beat the FIGHTING DOJO in SAFFRON CITY and pick one.
entries.hint: Next to a gym.
entries.title: HITMONLEE / HITMONCHAN

entries.answer: Pick the HELIX or DOME FOSSIL in MT. MOON; the OLD AMBER is in the back of PEWTER's museum. The CINNABAR ISLAND lab revives them.
entries.hint: A cave, a museum, and a lab.
entries.title: Fossils

entries.answer: The prize corner next to the CELADON CITY GAME CORNER trades coins for POKéMON: ABRA Lv9 (180 coins), CLEFAIRY Lv8 (500), DRATINI Lv18 (2800), SCYTHER Lv25 (5500), PORYGON Lv26 (9999). A man in the CELADON CITY restaurant gives you the COIN CASE.
entries.hint: Win coins in CELADON CITY.
entries.title: GAME CORNER prizes

entries.answer: The bottom of the SEAFOAM ISLANDS. Push boulders with STRENGTH to slow the currents.
entries.hint: Between FUCHSIA CITY and CINNABAR ISLAND.
entries.title: ARTICUNO

entries.answer: The POWER PLANT - SURF from ROUTE 10.
entries.hint: An abandoned building.
entries.title: ZAPDOS

entries.answer: The top of MT. EMBER on ONE ISLAND.
entries.hint: A volcano on the SEVII ISLANDS.
entries.title: MOLTRES

entries.answer: The bottom of CERULEAN CAVE, which opens after the SEVII ISLANDS story is finished.
entries.hint: Post-game, near CERULEAN CITY.
entries.title: MEWTWO

entries.answer: Two block ROUTE 12 and ROUTE 16. Wake them with the POKé FLUTE.
entries.hint: Sleeping in the way.
entries.title: SNORLAX

entries.answer: It's the last gym - it opens once you have the other seven badges.
entries.hint: Come back much later.
entries.title: VIRIDIAN CITY's gym is locked

entries.answer: BILL gives it to you after you help him in his cottage at the end of ROUTE 25, north of CERULEAN CITY.
entries.hint: Cross the bridge north of CERULEAN CITY.
entries.title: Where's the S.S. TICKET?

entries.answer: FLASH lights it up (HM05, see WHERE IS), but you can walk through without it.
entries.hint: An HM helps, but it's optional.
entries.title: ROCK TUNNEL is pitch black

randomized.answer: Pick up OAK's PARCEL at the VIRIDIAN CITY POKé MART and deliver it to PROF. OAK in PALLET TOWN. He moves after that.
randomized.hint: PROF. OAK is waiting for something from VIRIDIAN CITY.
randomized.title: An old man blocks the road north of VIRIDIAN

entries.answer: You need the SILPH SCOPE. It's on ROCKET HIDEOUT B4F, under the CELADON GAME CORNER - a switch behind a poster opens the entrance.
entries.hint: TEAM ROCKET has it, somewhere in CELADON CITY.
entries.title: I can't identify the ghosts in POKéMON TOWER

entries.answer: It needs the LIFT KEY, which a ROCKET on B4F drops. Take the stairs down to reach him.
entries.hint: Someone downstairs has a key.
entries.title: The hideout's elevator won't move

entries.answer: Rescue MR. FUJI from the top of POKéMON TOWER; he gives you the POKé FLUTE at his house in LAVENDER TOWN.
entries.hint: Something in LAVENDER TOWN wakes it.
entries.title: A SNORLAX blocks the road

entries.answer: Ride CYCLING ROAD south from CELADON CITY (BICYCLE needed), or go down ROUTES 12-15 from LAVENDER TOWN after waking the SNORLAX.
entries.hint: There are two ways - one needs wheels.
entries.title: How do I get to FUCHSIA CITY?

entries.answer: Find the CARD KEY on 5F; it opens every locked door in the building.
entries.hint: Somewhere in the middle floors.
entries.title: SILPH CO.'s doors are locked

randomized.answer: The gate guards are thirsty. Get TEA from the old woman on the ground floor of the CELADON CONDOMINIUMS and any guard lets you through.
randomized.hint: They'd like a drink - ask around CELADON CITY.
randomized.title: How do I get into SAFFRON CITY?

entries.answer: Teach STRENGTH and push boulders onto the floor switches to open the way.
entries.hint: An HM moves them.
entries.title: VICTORY ROAD's boulders

randomized.answer: The SECRET KEY is in the basement of the POKéMON MANSION on the same island.
randomized.title: CINNABAR ISLAND's gym is locked

entries.answer: After beating BLAINE, BILL is waiting at CINNABAR ISLAND and takes you to ONE ISLAND.
entries.hint: After the seventh badge, someone on CINNABAR ISLAND.
entries.title: How do I reach the SEVII ISLANDS?

entries.answer: Finish the SEVII ISLANDS story: bring the RUBY (MT. EMBER) and SAPPHIRE to CELIO on ONE ISLAND.
entries.hint: Two gems for CELIO.
entries.title: CERULEAN CAVE is guarded

randomized.answer: Beat the POKéMON LEAGUE, catch 60 kinds of KANTO POKéMON, then talk to PROF. OAK.
randomized.hint: Finish the League and keep catching.
randomized.title: How do I get the National Dex?
